title: fix: recover from chat transcript write errors
author: ale-rls
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #16442

- Catches transcript write errors in the shared save helper, preserving manual-save sessions for retry.
- Prints the CLI diagnostic and exits 1 when an autosave fails after readline closes.
- Adds one real-filesystem regression for failed save/retry/autosave; preserves the close handler so pending-save PR #16223 applies cleanly.
- Bumps CLI and its lockfile to 0.1.26 under the current publishing rule. Verified: all 284 CLI tests, build, Biome and four native save controls.

Strict TypeScript diagnostics remain identical to the 36 existing baseline errors. Local tests reused the installed dependency cache.

gist.headline: A second chance to save
gist.blurb: A transcript write error no longer ends the conversation about saving it. Polli CLI keeps manual-save sessions available for a retry and makes autosave failures hard to miss.
gist.summary: Polli CLI 0.1.26 catches chat transcript write errors so manual saves can be retried, while autosave failures print a diagnostic and exit with status 1.
gist.impact: CLI users can retry a failed manual transcript save; scripts can detect a failed autosave from its diagnostic and nonzero exit status.
gist.visual_concept: Polli CLI is a terminal tool, so show a cozy retro terminal beside a transcript notebook: a missed save becomes a visible retry, while a small warning on the screen represents the autosave diagnostic. Polli, wearing a tiny tool belt, helps the monitor robot place the transcript safely back on a shelf; code-plants and lime-green accents keep the scene warm.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden shed, a retro terminal displays a simple 'RETRY SAVE' message as Polli and a friendly CRT monitor robot carefully return a chat transcript notebook to a shelf among code-plants; soft lime green (#ecf874) glows prominently against warm cream, mint, and lavender pastel gradients, with dark purple (#110518) outlines. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings. She should be small-to-medium sized within the scene, sharing the frame with other elements — never oversized or dominating the image. Strictly pixel art style, never realistic. She wears a tiny tool belt and helps the robot steady the notebook; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful and emotionally warm.
